name: Lite Video
description: YouTube and Vimeo videos appear as a light poster with a play button. The real player, from youtube-nocookie.com or Vimeo, loads only when a visitor presses play.

panels.title: Lite video
panels.description: Every YouTube and Vimeo video on your pages becomes a poster with a play button. Nothing loads from YouTube or Vimeo until a visitor presses play. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Use lite videos
fields.description: Turn this off to show the normal players again.

fields.name: note
fields.title: Explain what pressing play does
fields.description: A short line on the poster saying the video plays from YouTube or Vimeo.

fields.name: thumbnails
fields.title: Show YouTube thumbnails
fields.description: Use the video's own picture as the poster. The picture comes from YouTube, so YouTube sees each visitor even before they press play. Off by default.

fields.name: remember
fields.title: Remember the visitor's choice
fields.description: After a visitor plays one video, load players straight away on their next visits. The choice is kept in their own browser only.
